headline: VFD Group 9-Month Profit Jumps 96% to N13 Billion on Investment Growth
summary: VFD Group Plc reported a 96% jump in profit to N13 billion for the nine months ended September 30, driven by investment-led growth.
why: VFD Group is a proprietary investment and financial services holding company in Nigeria, tracking its performance provides insight into regional private investment returns.

impacts.name: VFD Group
impacts.why: Net profit nearly doubled over the nine-month reporting period.
